name: ai4bcm-guidance
description: The AI4BCM guidance and its router. /ask-ai4bcm names the unit to read, the prompt to run and the maturity level the work needs, for AI use in business continuity management.

interface.shortDescription: Route a BCM situation to a unit, a prompt and a level
interface.longDescription: The AI4BCM guidance units, and the /ask-ai4bcm router that reads a situation and names the unit to read, the prompt to run, the maturity level the work needs and the data rule that runs first. It routes and hands over; it never runs a prompt itself.
